home.description: Explore international study, prepare your application and plan your next step with an ISG advisor.
home.introTitle: Big ambitions. A thoughtful starting point.
home.introText: International study can feel complicated. ISG helps you make sense of the options and prepare with purpose.
services: Understand your academic profile and explore study pathways that could suit your goals.
Get practical support with documents, personal statements and application requirements.
Work with an advisor who helps you navigate decisions and understand your next steps.
home.pathTitle: Where will your ambition take you?
home.pathText: A first degree, a new specialism or an original contribution. Start with the pathway that feels like you.
home.pathNote: Funding availability and provider requirements vary. Every pathway begins with your individual circumstances.
home.processTitle: A little clarity goes a long way.
home.processText: You don't have to figure everything out at once. Here's how we move forward together.
steps: Create your account and complete the short consultation form. No documents are needed yet.
Pay TZS 50,000 once and upload a private receipt.
ISG contacts you on WhatsApp and assigns a suitable package. Pay its fee and upload your receipt.
After package payment is verified, fill in your application form and follow status updates from ISG.
home.cityText: Study abroad starts with understanding the place as well as the programme. Explore your destination, language requirements and everyday life alongside your academic options.
stories: Explore how international study can connect communities and ideas.
Learn alongside people with different experiences and perspectives.
Understand the places, languages and institutions behind your study choices.
Build knowledge you can carry into the next chapter of your life.
home.careText: Good guidance starts with honesty. Understand the support, the costs and the opportunities before deciding how to proceed.
carePoints: No applications sent without your authorization
No sensitive documents in your first assessment
home.faqTitle: A few things you might be wondering.
home.faqText: Clear answers before you take your next step.
home.ctaTitle: Your next chapter starts with a conversation.
home.ctaText: Bring your ambition. We'll help you understand the path ahead.

faqs: What does ISG help me with?
We help you understand study pathways, review your academic profile and prepare applications. The support and any fees are agreed before paid work begins.
No. Scholarship providers, universities and immigration authorities make their own decisions. An initial assessment does not guarantee funding, admission or a visa.
Do I need an account to start?
Yes. Create an account with your email and password before starting a consultation. Email confirmation is not required to register. Your progress is saved in your account.
Will I know where applications are sent?
Yes. You receive provider details, requirements, relevant costs and data-sharing information before authorizing an application.
How much does the service cost?
Consultation costs TZS 50,000. ISG contacts you on WhatsApp and assigns a package with clear fees. Complete the application after package payment is verified.
Your information is used to review your goals and contact you. Marketing consent is optional. Your profile is not published or shared with an institution without appropriate authorization.

workspace.The principles that guide your use of th: The principles that guide your use of the ISG platform.
workspace.ISG provides education advisory and appl: ISG provides education advisory and application support. It does not award scholarships, grant admission or issue visas. Information is general until reviewed for your circumstances. Providers may change requirements, fees and deadlines.
workspace.Provide accurate information, protect yo: Provide accurate information, protect your account and review documents before approving them. Do not share official application portal passwords. Use the platform lawfully and do not attempt to access another person’s data or internal research.
workspace.Before authorizing a proposed applicatio: Before authorizing a proposed application, you must receive the provider details, relevant selection requirements, material costs and information about where your data will be sent. No initial assessment constitutes permission to submit an application.
workspace.An enquiry does not create a paid engage: An enquiry does not create a paid engagement. The agreed service quote must specify fees, currency, scope, payment arrangements and cancellation or refund terms. No general refund schedule is published until ISG approves one. Ask for these terms before paying.
workspace.Funding, admissions and immigration deci: Funding, admissions and immigration decisions are made independently by the relevant bodies. Neither an assessment nor payment guarantees a scholarship, admission or visa.
workspace.Read the privacy information before subm: Read the privacy information before submitting an assessment. Contact ISG about corrections or personal data requests. Do not include sensitive documents in an initial enquiry.
workspace.A straightforward explanation of the sto: A straightforward explanation of the storage used by this release.
workspace.When authentication is configured, Supab: When authentication is configured, Supabase session cookies keep you signed in and support secure session renewal. Signing out removes the current session. The assessment form keeps its temporary progress in component memory; it does not save your personal details in browser storage.
workspace.Cloudflare Turnstile is used on public s: Cloudflare Turnstile is used on public submissions and authentication when configured. It processes security signals to assess automated abuse. See Cloudflare’s Turnstile privacy information for details.
workspace.This release does not include advertisin: This release does not include advertising cookies or optional analytics. A separate consent choice must be implemented before adding any tracking that requires it.
workspace.You can clear cookies in your browser se: You can clear cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential account cookies may prevent sign-in from working.
